initial_prompt: Create a production sprite atlas for GOLEM, the heavy hammer fighter in a 2D fighting game. Match the reference Rook sheet's crisp outlined 16-bit pixel-art finish and small full-body scale, but make an original stocky powerful stone-and-bronze golem with brown rocky body, bronze shoulder armor, amber glowing eyes and a SHORT-HANDLED stone warhammer. No human hair, distinct broad silhouette. Precisely EIGHT separate complete poses in 4 columns and 2 rows on a square canvas. All face RIGHT. Top: idle, walking, defensive hammer block, jumping. Bottom: quick hammer jab, heavy downward hammer blow, compact amber shockwave hammer strike, hurt recoil. Transparent alpha background. The entire hammer AND every effect MUST stay within that figure's own column with generous empty margins; draw small compact sprites, only 60% of each cell's width. Same body size every pose, same armor. Special effect compact, never a giant halo. No poses touching, no overlapping figures, no text, no grid, no ground plane, no UI. Use ample padding around each sprite; ground feet align per row. Canvas 1280x1280, each cell320x640.
